parameters.query:
SELECT l.key, l.plan, l.max_machines, l.expires_at, l.revoked,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM activations a WHERE a.licence_key = l.key) AS nb_activations,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activations a WHERE a.licence_key = l.key AND a.machine_id = $2) AS deja_active
FROM licences l
WHERE l.key = $1;

INSERT INTO activations (licence_key, machine_id, app_version)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (licence_key, machine_id)
DO UPDATE SET last_seen = now(), app_version = EXCLUDED.app_version
RETURNING id;
DELETE FROM activations WHERE licence_key = $1 AND machine_id = $2 RETURNING id;
